helps.spawn: Defines where players respawn when they die or use /spawn.
helps.teleport: Settings related to teleporting between locations.
helps.teleport-cooldown: Time (in seconds) a player must wait between teleports.
helps.kits: List of available kits for players and their properties (delay, items).
helps.worth: Value table for items used by the economy system.
helps.economy: Settings for the economy plugin integrated with Essentials.
helps.allow-fly: Allows players to fly if their mode supports it.
helps.motd: Message shown to players when they connect to the server.
helps.chat: Options related to chat (formats, filters, etc.).
helps.spawn-protection: Area around spawn protected from player modifications.
helps.debug: Enables additional debugging messages on the server.
